headline: Coffee-ground cocoa alternative; high-fibre white bread wheat; '0g sugar' keto bread lawsuit
summary: An entrepreneur profiled by CBC is turning spent coffee grounds into a cocoa replacer to offset high cocoa costs, a scouting or partnership lead for Belcolade compounds.

A UK consortium led by John Innes Centre and Imperial College sets out how high-fibre white-flour wheat can deliver more fibre in white bread, which could shift demand for Puratos fibre-enrichment solutions.
A US class action over Lewis Bake Shop's '0g sugar' keto bread claim shows the legal risk of sugar claims, so Puratos should help bakery customers substantiate low-sugar labels.
New research on how sourdough microbial communities establish in artisanal bakeries supports Sapore starter development.
Chocolate processors keep investing despite cocoa pressures, and Asian-style bakery chains and fast-growing bagel brands are expanding in the US as potential Puratos customers.

items.title: Exploiting New Opportunities to Deliver High Fibre in White Bread and Other Bakery Products
items.summary: UK expert meeting report on breeding wheat with higher soluble fibre in white flour and getting high-fibre white bread to consumers.
items.why: High-fibre white flour wheat could reshape fibre-enrichment demand; Puratos Bakery could position improvers and partner with John Innes on high-DF flour bread performance.

items.title: Could old coffee grounds help offset high cocoa costs? This entrepreneur is betting on it
items.summary: CBC profiles an entrepreneur developing a cocoa alternative made from spent coffee grounds to offset high cocoa costs.
items.why: An upcycled coffee-ground cocoa replacer is a potential partnership or scouting target for Belcolade compound and cocoa-reduced products.

items.title: Parallel microbial community successions during sourdough establishment in artisanal bakeries
items.summary: Study tracking how microbial communities develop in parallel as sourdoughs are established in artisanal bakeries.
items.why: Insight into sourdough establishment dynamics supports Sapore starter design and the Puratos sourdough library.

items.title: Lewis Bake Shop Keto Bread “0g Sugar” Lawsuit
items.summary: Class action against Lewis Bake Shop alleging its keto bread's '0g sugar' label is misleading.
items.why: US keto/low-sugar bread makers face litigation risk on sugar claims; Puratos Bakery should help customers substantiate sugar claims (including sugars formed during baking) when supplying sugar-reduction solutions.

items.title: Chocolate processing forging ahead despite global tests
items.summary: Confectionery Production feature on chocolate processors continuing to invest despite global cocoa price and supply pressures.
items.why: Signals how chocolate processors are adapting to cocoa volatility; Belcolade should benchmark its processing and sourcing moves against peers.

items.title: Effects of pumpkin (Cucurbita pepo L.) flesh waste flour on the technological, textural, and sensory properties of bread
items.summary: Turkish study substituting bread flour with pumpkin flesh waste flour (2.5-20%); 2.5% kept loaf volume while higher levels cut volume and darkened crumb.
items.why: Upcycled vegetable flours are usable only at low inclusion in bread, a useful benchmark for upcycled-fibre improver or mix concepts.
